items.title: 10.6 Induced emf aur Faraday ka qanoon (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.6 in the book's order (PDF 238-240), with the Eq. 10.23 reference correction and self-checks.

blocks.text: Tajurbe se dekha gaya hai ke jab koi conductor magnetic field ke aar paar chalta hai to us ke dono siron ke darmiyan electromotive force (emf) paida (induce) hoti hai. Chalte conductor ki yeh emf battery jaisi hai: agar conductor ke siron ko taar se jor kar band circuit bana dein to us mein current behne lagta hai.

blocks.title: Motional emf
blocks.text: Magnetic field ke aar paar conductor ki harkat (motion) se paida hone wali emf ko motional emf kehte hain.

Fig. 10.13 ka tajurba dekhein. Lambai L ki conducting rod do mutawazi (parallel) dhaati patriyon (rails) par rakhi hai jin ka faasla bhi L hai. Patriyon ke siron c aur d ke darmiyan galvanometer laga hai. Is tarah mukammal loop abcda banta hai. Uniform magnetic field B kaghaz ke andar ki taraf hai. Shuru mein rod ruki ho to galvanometer koi current nahi dikhata. Agar rod ko mustaqil velocity v se daen khaincha jaye to galvanometer current dikhata hai. Saaf hai ke yeh current rod ki field ke aar paar harkat se paida hua hai; chalti rod emf ka source ban jati hai: ε = V_b − V_a = ΔV.

blocks.alt: Do ufuqi patriyan (rails), oopar sira c aur neeche sira d, baen taraf galvanometer se juri hain. Tanbe ki rod ab (b oopar, a neeche) un ke aar paar hai; darmiyan hare hisse mein cross batate hain ke B kaghaz ke andar hai. Rod mein charge q velocity v se daen chalta hai. Current I ke teer: oopar wali patri par baen, galvanometer ke saath neeche aur neeche wali patri par daen. L patriyon ka faasla hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.13: Motional emf: kaghaz ke andar wali magnetic field mein patriyon par v se chalai gayi rod (kitab ki Figure 10.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rod daen chal rahi hai aur B kaghaz ke andar hai, is liye rod ke positive charges par force q v × B, a se b ki taraf (oopar) hai. Current rod mein oopar, oopar wali patri par c ki taraf baen, galvanometer se neeche aur neeche wali patri par daen behta hai: yani loop abcda mein anticlockwise.
Jab rod chalti hai to us ke andar ka charge q bhi usi velocity v se field B mein chalta hai aur us par Eq. 10.13 wali force lagti hai:

Right-hand rule lagane se pata chalta hai ke charge q par force F rod ke saath a se b ki taraf hai. Is liye charges rod ke upar wale sire ki taraf jama hone lagte hain: upar wale sire b par charge zyada aur neeche wale sire a par kam ho jata hai. Charge ki is nayi tarteeb se b se a ki taraf electrostatic field E banti hai, jo charge par b se a ki taraf force F_e = qE lagati hai. Jaldi hi aisi barabari (equilibrium) aa jati hai jis mein dono forces barabar hon. Agar is halat mein electric field E ho to:

Motional emf:
Is ki miqdar vBL hai; manfi alamat sirf simt ki taraf ishara hai (Lenz ka qanoon, topic 10.7). Agar v aur B ka zawiya θ ho to:

Induced emf ki wajah se positive charges raste abcda par behte hain, is liye diagram mein induced current anticlockwise hai. Current behne se upar wale sire ka charge kam hota hai, electric field kamzor hoti hai, magar magnetic force wahi rehti hai. Barabari magnetic force ke haq mein toot jati hai. Chunanche jo charges circuit se ho kar neeche wale sire a tak pohanchte hain, unhein magnetic force phir upar sire b tak le jati hai, aur current chalta rehta hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Wireless charging electromagnetic induction ke usool par kaam karti hai (kitab mein 'woks' chhapa hai, matlab works).

blocks.title: Point to ponder!
blocks.text: Yeh heater electromagnetic induction ke usool par chalta hai. Dhaat (metal) ke bartan mein pani ubal raha hai magar sheeshe (glass) ke bartan mein nahi. Heater ki sheeshe ki upar wali satah bhi chhoone mein thandi rehti hai. Satah ke bilkul neeche coil mein ac (alternating current) behta hai jo badalta magnetic flux banata hai. Bartanon se guzarne wala flux un mein emf paida karta hai. Metal ke bartan mein current banta hai jo pani garam karta hai, magar sheeshe ke bartan mein koi current nahi behta. Kyun? (Ishara: emf to dono mein banti hai, magar current ke liye conductor chahiye; sheesha insulator hai.)
Faraday ka qanoon

Field ke perpendicular chalti rod mein motional emf ε = −vBL hai. Motional emf aur baqi induced emfs ko magnetic flux ke zariye bhi bayan kiya ja sakta hai. Fig. 10.14 ka tajurba dobara dekhein. Rod chhote se waqt Δt mein position 1 se position 2 tak jati hai. Is waqt mein rod ka tay kiya faasla x₂ − x₁ = Δx hai.

blocks.alt: Wahi patriyan aur galvanometer; rod Position 1 par dashed aur Position 2 par solid. Neeche x1 galvanometer wale sire se Position 1 tak, Δx Position 1 se Position 2 tak, aur x2 galvanometer wale sire se Position 2 tak. Dono positions ke darmiyan ki patti ΔA hai; L patriyon ka faasla; current I oopar wali patri par baen; B kaghaz ke andar.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.14: Rod Position 1 se Position 2 tak Δx chalti hai aur loop ka raqba ΔA barhta hai (kitab ki Figure 10.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Waqt Δt mein rod Δx = x₂ − x₁ chalti hai, is liye loop ka raqba ΔA = LΔx barhta hai aur flux Δϕ = BΔA barhta hai. Isi se ε = −Δϕ/Δt nikalta hai.
Rod mustaqil velocity v se chal rahi hai, is liye:
v ki yeh qeemat Eq. 10.19 mein rakhein:
Rod Δx chale to loop ka raqba ΔA = ΔxL barhta hai, aur loop se flux Δϕ = (ΔA)B barhta hai. Eq. 10.22 mein (ΔxL)B = Δϕ rakhein:
Eq. 10.23 batati hai ke agar conducting coil ke ek loop se magnetic flux badal raha ho, to loop mein induced emf flux ki tabdeeli ki sharah (rate, fi second tabdeeli) ke manfi ke barabar hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Eqation(10.20)' likhti hai, magar Eq. 10.20 to ε = −vBL sinθ hai. Flux ki tabdeeli wali equation ε = −Δϕ/Δt Eq. 10.23 hai, is liye sahi hawala Eq. 10.23 hai.
Agar ek loop ki jagah N loops wali coil ho to induced emf N guna ho jati hai:
Yeh formula motional emf se nikala gaya hai, magar har haal mein sahi hai. Yeh nateeja sab se pehle Faraday ne nikala, is liye ise Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka qanoon kehte hain:

blocks.title: Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka qanoon
blocks.text: N loops wali conducting coil mein induced ausat (average) emf us sharah ke manfi ke barabar hai jis se coil se guzarne wala magnetic flux waqt ke saath badal raha ho.
Manfi (minus) alamat batati hai ke induced emf ki simt aisi hoti hai ke woh flux ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat (oppose) kare.

blocks.title: Point to Ponder
blocks.text: Copper ka ek chhalla (ring) aise mustateel hisse se guzarta hai jahan mustaqil magnetic field kaghaz ke andar ki taraf hai. Positions 2, 3 aur 4 par chhalle mein current ke bare mein aap ka kya andaza hai?

blocks.alt: Tanbe ka chhalla positions 1 se 5 tak seedha neeche girta hai. Positions 2 aur 4 mustateel field wale hisse (cross: field kaghaz ke andar) ke oopar aur neeche kinare par hain, aur position 3 us ke andar hai. Position 2 par chhalle ke oopar khamdaar teer anticlockwise, aur position 4 par chhalle ke neeche khamdaar teer clockwise hai.
blocks.caption: Point to Ponder (PDF page 240): Tanbe ka chhalla aise mustateel hisse se guzarta hai jahan mustaqil magnetic field kaghaz ke andar hai; positions 2, 3 aur 4 par chhalle mein current (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Position 2 par chhalla field mein dakhil ho raha hai: andar ki taraf flux barh raha hai, is liye current anticlockwise behta hai taa ke us ki field (kaghaz se bahar) is izafe ki mukhalifat kare. Position 3 par chhalla poora andar hai, flux nahi badalta, current zero. Position 4 par chhalla nikal raha hai, flux ghat raha hai, is liye current clockwise hai.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Yeh wahi heater hai jo upar 'Point to ponder!' mein hai (kitab ne yeh baat do dafa chhapi hai): coil ka ac badalta flux banata hai, bartanon mein emf banti hai, metal ke bartan mein current pani garam karta hai, sheeshe ke bartan mein current nahi behta.

blocks.prompt: Copper ka chhalla aise mustateel hisse se guzarta hai jahan mustaqil magnetic field kaghaz ke andar hai; positions 2 (dakhil hote), 3 (poora andar) aur 4 (nikalte) par chhalle mein current ka kya hota hai (Point to Ponder)? Ek murabba (square) loop uniform field mein chalta hai aur us ka normal field ke parallel hai; kya emf induce hoti hai (short question 10.2)?
blocks.explanation: 2 par chhalle se flux barh raha hai, is liye current induce hota hai; 3 par chhalla poori tarah uniform field mein hai, flux mustaqil hai, current zero; 4 par flux ghat raha hai, is liye current ulti simt mein behta hai. Murabba loop ke liye uniform field mein chalte hue flux BA mustaqil rehta hai, is liye koi emf induce nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: 15 cm side aur 60 turns wali murabba coil 0.8 T field mein hai aur us ki satah field ke perpendicular hai; use 2 s mein 30° ghumaya jata hai. Ausat induced emf nikalein (numerical 10.3).
blocks.explanation: Shuru mein fi turn flux BA = 0.8 × 0.0225 = 1.80 × 10⁻² Wb; ghumane ke baad BA cos30° = 1.56 × 10⁻² Wb; tabdeeli 2.41 × 10⁻³ Wb. Ausat emf = NΔϕ/Δt = 60 × 2.41 × 10⁻³/2 = 7.2 × 10⁻² V. Kitab ka jawab 0.54 V tabhi aata hai jab poora flux, 60 × 1.80 × 10⁻² Wb, 2 s mein khatam ho jaye; yeh jaanch ke liye darj hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Motional emf: lambai L ki rod v se B ke aar paar; qvB charges ko rod ke saath dhakelti hai jab tak qE = qvB (10.17); emf ki miqdar vBL (kitab −LvB, 10.19), zawiye par vBL sinθ (10.20); induced current abcda par anticlockwise.
Faraday ka qanoon: ε = −Δϕ/Δt (10.23); N turns ke liye ε = −NΔϕ/Δt (10.24); manfi alamat ka matlab emf flux ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karti hai. Istemal: wireless chargers, induction heaters.
